metadata.title: Original executable replacement feasibility synthesis
metadata.subject: SporeApp.exe 3.1.0.22
metadata.purpose: Assess technically supported replacement seams without modifying or running the original executable.

answer_summary.summary: A 5-byte x86 entry detour is proven on a native 32-bit Linux synthetic. No replacement has been installed in SporeApp.exe, and no live Cell trace exists.
answer_summary.recommendation: Build a read-only preflight/identity validator, then a 32-bit ABI-compatible one-float shim and a reversible call-site or entry detour on a disposable copy/process with dedicated entry, return, and memory validation.
not_authorized_by_this_record: running the game as part of this synthesis
claiming current Cell field layout or runtime semantics are verified

evidence_vocabulary.CONFIRMED: Identity or contract supported by the committed SDK, direct byte evidence, or multiple independent committed sources.
evidence_vocabulary.VERIFIED: Byte-level or synthetic behavior was directly checked in the repository.
evidence_vocabulary.OBSERVED: Seen in a recorded runtime trace or direct inspection artifact; it does not by itself prove the complete semantic model.
evidence_vocabulary.SUPPORTED: Multiple static evidence sources support the interpretation.
evidence_vocabulary.INFERRED: Reasoned from partial decompilation, SDK structure, or xrefs; not runtime-confirmed.
evidence_vocabulary.APPROXIMATION: A stand-in or guessed value/layout used for a bounded experiment, not an original contract.
evidence_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: No reliable evidence is currently available.
evidence_vocabulary.decompiler_boundary: Ghidra output is evidence, not truth; the original has no MSVC RTTI.

binary_and_address_conventions.linked_va_formula: linked VA = image base + PE RVA
binary_and_address_conventions.file_offset_rule: Resolve file offsets through the PE section mapping; do not subtract the image base from every historical artifact field.
binary_and_address_conventions.engine_layout: Engine code is statically linked in SporeApp.exe; there are no engine DLLs to replace as units.
binary_and_address_conventions.rtti_consequence: Class hierarchy and object identity must not be inferred from RTTI; vtable data, SDK names, and xrefs remain distinct evidence types.
binary_and_address_conventions.tooling: Wine-hosted 32-bit ptrace/INT3 tracing is the existing analysis runtime.

supported_mechanisms.safe_use: Only an actual PE import entry point.
supported_mechanisms.limitations: Does not intercept an internal function merely because it has an SDK name.

supported_mechanisms.safe_use: Confirmed object dispatch with a proven vtable base and slot.
supported_mechanisms.limitations: No MSVC RTTI; static vtable association is not runtime object identity proof.

supported_mechanisms.safe_use: One proven call site or narrowly bounded call chain.
supported_mechanisms.limitations: Misses other callers and requires exact call-instruction and argument evidence.

supported_mechanisms.safe_use: A pointer with a proven writer, reader, lifetime, and synchronization model.
supported_mechanisms.limitations: Unknown writer/reader and lifetime make an in-place write unsafe.

supported_mechanisms.safe_use: All callers entering a function at a proven instruction boundary.
supported_mechanisms.limitations: Existing synthetic has no production unhook, relocator, range check, page-boundary handling, or thread safety.

supported_mechanisms.safe_use: The original must remain callable or callers need fall-through behavior.
supported_mechanisms.limitations: Requires instruction decoding, relocation, exact return behavior, and lifetime management.

supported_mechanisms.safe_use: Host code may expose a wrapper, but interception still needs one concrete attachment mechanism above.
supported_mechanisms.limitations: A wrapper alone does not modify or observe the original binary.

synthetic_replacement.implementation: Linux-native 32-bit non-PIE target using mprotect, a 5-byte E9 rel32 entry jump, readback validation, and original-byte retention.
proven: BEFORE calls reach the original function and not the replacement
AFTER redirected behavior and replacement execution flag
mprotect and E9 rel32 encoding behavior
synthetic_replacement.constraint: It is not a Spore installer and has not patched SporeApp.exe.

observatory.implementation: 32-bit ptrace/INT3 tracer with module discovery, temporary breakpoints, function-entry JSONL events, register snapshots, and detach restoration.
not_available: a dedicated side-effect and aggregate-return oracle

historical_reachability.interpretation: Cell mode was never entered; this is a negative result, not a failed Cell implementation.

host_compat_seams.meaning: Real host abstractions for resource, mesh, and renderer substitution.
host_compat_seams.not_meaning: They are not ABI-compatible replacements for original SporeApp.exe functions or calls.

host_replacement_stand_in.observed_signature: four arguments: float, SCellGameView*, CameraView*, MovementPlane*
host_replacement_stand_in.original_target_signature: one float argument, void return, cdecl likely/inferred
host_replacement_stand_in.consequence: The current host function cannot be jumped to as the original target.

missing_components.why_needed: Resolve PE identity, linked VA/RVA/file offset, current target bytes, module mapping, global address, callers, and vtable/import evidence before any write.
missing_components.gate: No patch or game run is needed for this component.

missing_components.why_needed: The existing host stand-in has the wrong four-argument signature and cannot be directly installed.
missing_components.gate: Native disposable harness and explicit cdecl/return/register contract.

missing_components.why_needed: The synthetic constructor has no unhook, relocator, range check, page-boundary logic, or thread quiescence.
missing_components.gate: Disposable process only until all patch lifecycle checks pass.

missing_components.why_needed: Entry-only INT3 probes cannot validate return values, hidden sret data, callee-saved registers, or side effects.
missing_components.gate: Record entry, return/continuation, memory, and lifecycle observables for each selected call.

missing_components.why_needed: Current field meanings, plane point, global address conflict, and target reachability cannot be promoted from static evidence.
missing_components.gate: Reach Cell Stage with controlled display/input and capture the existing probe set plus return/memory observations.

rules.stack_arguments: Passed according to the exact prototype and observed entry layout.
rules.return_address: The return address remains on the stack for a normal call/entry jump.
rules.stack_balance: ESP must be balanced; match RET versus RET N exactly.
rules.callee_saved: EBX, EBP, ESI, and EDI must be preserved under the applicable convention.
rules.wide_returns: EDX:EAX may carry a wide scalar return; select by prototype and verify.
rules.aggregate_returns: A caller-provided hidden sret pointer may be stack-passed; prove its location and lifetime.
rules.floating_point: Read and return floats according to the original x86 ABI and observed machine code.
rules.exceptions: No selected target has an observed local SEH frame, but the original contains SEH elsewhere; global exception irrelevance is not established.

current_target_abi.convention: cdecl likely/inferred; return and one-float parameter are SDK-confirmed
current_target_abi.entry_frame: An entry jump inherits the caller ESP/argument layout; a replacement must return with the frame balanced.

App::cPropManager::SetDevMode as a scratch receiver memory-effect test after object/slot confirmation
Simulator::cCreatureGameData::SetEvolutionPoints as a cdecl float global-store test if reachability is confirmed
Math::MatrixToEuler only after hidden-sret ABI confirmation

required_but_missing: return values at call-site continuation or trampoline return
post-call ESP and RET/RET N verification
hidden-sret address and aggregate output capture
per_call_record: entry EIP, ESP, EBP, EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX, ESI, EDI, EFLAGS
original argument words and float interpretation
return EAX, EDX, ESP, flags, and return instruction behavior
target global/receiver/player/scratch memory before and after
thread ID, caller, call count, detach/unhook state, and crash status

validation_workflow.name: read_only_preflight
actions: verify PE identity, image base, linked VA, true RVA, and file offset
verify entry instruction boundary and expected bytes
verify loaded module mapping without patching
resolve current global address and caller/vtable/import evidence

validation_workflow.name: abi_harness
actions: build a 32-bit one-float void shim
test cdecl argument and stack layout
test RET/RET N and callee-saved register behavior
keep the existing four-argument host stand-in separate

validation_workflow.name: reversible_detour_containment
actions: add instruction-boundary validation
add rel32 range and page-boundary checks
retain exact original bytes
implement unhook
quiesce or synchronize all affected threads

validation_workflow.name: behaviorless_positive_control
actions: select a startup-reachable trivial target such as App::IAppSystem::Get
validate entry, return, and memory oracle records
detach and restore before any broader test

validation_workflow.name: cell_reachability_and_target_oracle
actions: reach Cell Stage using controlled display/input
capture the existing Cell probe set
capture return and memory observables
resolve the global address and field-layout conflict

validation_workflow.name: current_target_decision
actions: review ABI and oracle evidence
evaluate reversible call-site versus entry detour
use a disposable process or copy only
do not infer live parity from decompilation-only 64/64 host comparison

safety_constraints: Do not modify SPORE or any original binary.
Do not install a replacement into SporeApp.exe as part of this feasibility record.
Use a disposable process or disposable copy for any future write experiment.
Resolve current binary identity and address mappings before any patch.
Do not assume a host C++ signature is an original x86 ABI signature.
Do not treat static vtable association as MSVC RTTI or runtime object identity.
Do not replace statically linked engine internals through the PE import table.
Do not patch a function entry without checking instruction boundaries and rel32 reachability.
Do not patch while another tracer owns the same bytes; INT3 and an entry detour conflict.
Preserve original bytes and provide an exact unhook path.
Quiesce or synchronize threads before writing executable pages and before removal.
Capture return, stack, register, memory, thread, and lifecycle evidence; entry-only probes are insufficient.
Keep the movement replacement at approximation status until positive live Cell evidence exists.

current_status.next_gate: read-only preflight and dedicated entry/return/memory oracle before any disposable detour experiment
